prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Conroe, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1277; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the intersection in Conroe, Texas. Can you state your full name for the record?

A: Sure. I'm the driver of the vehicle involved. I'd rather not give my full name on tape, but I'm happy to go on with the details.

Q: That's fine. We can identify you by your claim number instead. Can you describe what happened?

A: I was heading through the intersection on the green light. A pickup coming from my right didn't stop for the red and crossed in front of me. I tried to brake, but he hit the driver's side of my car.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Only for a second. I saw it moving fast and I hit the brakes, but there wasn't time to avoid it.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, and the airbag on my side did deploy.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: My neck is pretty sore. It's stiff when I turn my head, and I've got a dull ache across the back of my shoulders. I had some headaches the first couple of days too.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment?

A: I went to the emergency room that afternoon. They took X-rays, said it was a neck strain, and gave me muscle relaxers and a referral to a physical therapist. I've been going to therapy twice a week since.

Q: Did you have any neck or back problems before this accident?

A: No, not that I can remember. I had a little stiffness now and then from sitting at a desk, but nothing I ever needed to see a doctor about.

Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?

A: A few days right after the crash. I'm back now, but I'm on lighter duty and I can't lift much.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Just that I was following the rules and I didn't do anything to cause this. I'd like to get my car fixed and get my neck back to normal.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
